answer: A sybil farm is throttled when reputation comes only from attested work credits that cannot be sold or merged. Each identity starts at zero and gains credit when unrelated peers confirm its output; endorsers are drawn from a rotating seat pool that costs capital to hold, so a clone cannot sponsor its twin. Credit decays unless the same account keeps producing, so a fresh key inherits nothing. A ring of fakes needs one funded seat per voice. Every credential becomes a costly relic, and a ripple of clones still pays to be heard once in the cedar of honest nodes.
